parameter_descriptions.bandwidth_density_estimation: Bandwidth for density estimation of mass errors (st parameter). Controls smoothness of error distribution.
parameter_descriptions.tolerance_dalton: Tolerance in Daltons for calibrant hits generation (tl parameter). Must capture all possible mass shifts.
parameter_descriptions.local_tolerance_window: Tolerance window around most frequent mass error (lm parameter). Defines final calibration precision.

usage_notes.reference_file: TXT file with internal calibrant masses (one per line)
usage_notes.algorithm: RANSAC-based selection of endogenous biological signals
